modules.title: 查询请求如何通过 MCP 获取真实系统结果
一次 get_ticket 查询里，谁负责什么

items.title: 配置与服务公开查询工具
items.text: 在 AI 工具设置中填入服务器命令即可启用 MCP 服务。服务（Server）告诉应用自己具备哪些工具（如 get_ticket）以及需要什么参数。

items.title: AI 应用发起调用
items.text: 模型提出 get_ticket({ id: 1024 })，应用中的 MCP Client 按协议把请求交给工单服务。

items.title: 工单系统返回真实记录
items.text: 工单系统检查测试账号只能读取，随后返回 #1024 的负责人；MCP 不会替它保存数据或判断权限。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: MCP 不是 get_ticket 工具，也不是工单服务本身。它规定应用与服务怎样发现能力和交换调用；账号权限、真实工单和高风险确认仍由应用及工单系统负责。

lessonPractice.title: 用户问“工单 #1024 谁负责”。应用通过 MCP 发现 get_ticket 工具后，下一步哪种做法正确？

options.label: 由应用请求 get_ticket({ id: 1024 })，让工单系统检查当前账号权限并返回真实记录
options.feedback: 对。MCP 负责发现工具和传递调用，工单系统仍负责权限与真实数据。

options.label: 使用了 MCP 就说明已经获得权限，可以跳过工单系统的账号检查
options.feedback: 连接协议不等于授权，是否能读 #1024 仍要由工单系统判断。

options.label: 让模型根据工单编号猜一个负责人，不必真正调用工具
options.feedback: 负责人必须来自工具返回的真实记录，不能由模型猜测。

en.title: A user asks who owns issue #1024. After the application discovers get_ticket through MCP, what should happen next?

options.label: The app requests get_ticket({ id: 1024 }), and the issue tracker checks the current account before returning the real record
options.feedback: Correct. MCP handles tool discovery and the call; the issue tracker still handles authorization and real data.

options.label: Because it uses MCP, the application can skip the issue tracker's account check
options.feedback: A connection protocol is not authorization. The issue tracker still decides whether this account may read #1024.

options.label: Let the model guess an owner from the issue number without calling the tool
options.feedback: The owner must come from the real record returned by the tool, not a model guess.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请通过 MCP 用测试账号只读查询工单 #1024。先确认工单服务公开了 get_ticket，再显示实际调用参数、账号权限和工具返回；不要开放关闭或删除工单的能力。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Use MCP to retrieve issue #1024 with a read-only test account. First confirm that the issue service exposes get_ticket, then show the actual arguments, account permission, and tool result. Do not expose close or delete actions.

references.title: MCP 入门
references.title_en: What is the Model Context Protocol?

learning.assumes: You know an AI agent can use tools to read files or call an outside service.
learning.outcome: You can identify the application, server, and tool in one connection while keeping permission checks in place.

modules.title: How does a real answer return after “Who owns issue #1024?”
Who does what in one get_ticket lookup?

items.title: Configuring and exposing tools
items.text: Add server command configs in your AI tool settings. The MCP server announces which tools (like get_ticket) it exposes and what arguments they expect.

items.title: The AI application requests the call
items.text: The model proposes get_ticket({ id: 1024 }), and the MCP client sends it to the issue service.

items.title: The issue tracker returns the real record
items.text: It checks the test account's read access and returns the owner. MCP does not store the issue or decide permission.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: MCP is not the get_ticket tool or the issue service itself. It standardizes discovery and calls; the application and issue tracker still own authorization, real records, and high-risk confirmation.
